mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.food_id, d.name AS food_name, d.price, d.image_url, f.created_at FROM favorite f JOIN food d ON d.id = f.food_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND food_id = #{foodId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND food_id = #{foodId}
